body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Phoenix Technologies Ltd., a global market leader in system firmware that provides the most secure foundation for today's computing environments, is readying a unique lineup for CES 2009 that includes "a whole new dimension for notebooks and netbooks, making the personal computer as fast, friendly and fun as a mobile phone." Find out more during the show at booth 9014 in the Central Hall.

The PC industry's top system builders and specifiers trust Phoenix to pioneer open standards and deliver innovative solutions that will help them differentiate their systems, reduce time-to-market and increase their revenues. The company's flagship products and services -- AwardCore, Phoenix SecureCore, Embedded BIOS, Phoenix FailSafe, HyperSpace, BeInSync and eSupport -- are revolutionizing the PC user experience by delivering unprecedented performance, security, reliability, continuity, and ease-of-use.
